name: Mitten Extracts Moonrocks | Sour Diesel
description: Sharp, gassy, and unmistakably bold, Sour Diesel Moon Rocks bring classic diesel flavor with a tangy citrus edge. Infused flower and kief amplify the intensity, creating a high-impact experience for fans of powerful strains.
